greet.text: Information is the only treasure that grows when shared, and the price grows with it. What do you want to know?

choices.label: Buy a rumour about Azure Peak. (20 stones)
Buy a map to a hidden spirit vein. (120 stones)
Sell him the Ancient Jade Slip. (+600 stones)
Ask about the Blood Lotus Sect.

peak.text: A cave on the peak holds a dead cultivator's legacy. A stone guardian watches it. Do not go before Foundation Establishment.

vein.text: Two days north-west. Absorb it quickly; such veins scatter within a season.

slip.text: A pleasure doing business. Don't tell anyone where you sold it.

blood_lotus.text: You've the right look for them. They recruit anyone at the Sect Envoy Hall, cultivation or not. Strength is all they respect.
